page.overview:
Who is Adomo?

Adomo was a female fathier with brown fur and black eyes who was born around 0 ABY. During 3 ABY, the fathier and jockey Keeka Grim were set up by the Crimson Dawn crime syndicate to win a fixed fathier race as part of the Canto Cup tournament in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. At the time of the race, Adomo stood 295 centimeters tall and weighed 901 kilograms.

Prior to the arranged race, the scoundrel Kay Vess met former champion jockey Morin Bryte while looking to place a bet at a holographic fathier-betting module located in Mirogana, the capital city of the moon Toshara. After talking with Vess about the growing corruption in fathier races, Bryte gave Vess a datacard indicating Adomo's jockey would win the race. Vess then placed a bet on Adomo and watched the fathier win via the table's hologram.

Adomo appeared as a hologram during the optional "Fixed Fathier Races" quest in the 2024 video game Star Wars Outlaws developed by Massive Entertainment and published by Ubisoft. The racing symbol and color assigned to Adomo is randomized per playthrough, as are the fathiers who compete against Adomo in the quest. Unlike other fathiers in the race who are matched with a random jockey, Grim consistently served as Adomo's jockey.
